email.body1:
Lea, saw Revalize launched its new Partner Program and expanded across Europe with the PROCAD, SpecPage, and TENADO acquisitions.

That much expansion usually means more in-market accounts than the team can route and act on before signals go stale. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Revalize off your hiring and tech-stack data, and accounts showing those signals tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Lea, quick follow-up for Revalize.

For RevOps, the drag after expansion is latency: signals fire across more regions, but nobody touches them fast enough, so qualified pipeline decays in the queue. That gap usually surfaces late, after a quarter is already at risk.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through a teardown of your current outbound, three things I'd change, and our best practices alone usually lift reply rates 50-70%.
email.body3:
Lea, last bit of proof for Revalize.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Revalize's reply rate likely compares to similar software teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
